highlights: Earn up to 6% cashback in voucher rebates at Takashimaya Department Store on retail, health, and supermarket purchases. Additionally, receive 0.17% cashback on local and overseas spending, with every S$1 spent equaling 0.2 points, redeemable for S$10 cash credit after accumulating 1,200 points.
pros: Get 6% voucher rebates in Takashimaya Department Store (Earn 2 Takashimaya Bonus Points with every S$10 charged)
pros: Get 2% voucher rebates in Takashimaya Shopping Centre (Earn 2 Takashimaya Bonus Points with every S$30 charged)
pros: Redeem S$30 worth of Takashimaya Gift Vouchers with every 100 Takashimaya Bonus Points.
pros: Enjoy additional 10% off during selected sale events at Takashimaya Department Store.
pros: Enjoy up to 5% discount at selected Takashimaya stores in Asia.
cons: Rebates can only be redeemed for Takashimaya vouchers.

extra.description: Shop to your heart's content with the DBS Takashimaya American Express Card. This shopping credit card allows you to receive up to 6% voucher rebates on your Takashimaya spend, plus an additional 10% off during selected sale events.
